RBI/2025-26/05
DOR.CRE.REC.No.07/08.12.001/2025-26

April 01, 2025

All Scheduled Commercial Banks (excluding RRBs)

Madam / Dear Sir,

Master Circular – Housing Finance

This Master Circular consolidates instructions on housing finance issued up to March 31, 2025. Banks should ensure that the loan-to-value ratio for individual housing loans up to Rs 30 lakh does not exceed 90 per cent of the value of the property.

(Vaibhav Chaturvedi)
Chief General Manager
